paper.title_en: Thermal and non-thermal emission from supermassive black hole circumbinary disks: Disks, Coronae, Streams, and Cavities
paper.abstract_en: The search for electromagnetic signals from supermassive black hole (SMBH) binary systems is one of the cornerstones of multi-messenger astrophysics, complementing gravitational wave observations of such systems by pulsar timing arrays and LISA. Although extensive simulations have been run to understand the time variability of the bolometric luminosity from accreting binary SMBH systems, comparatively few spectral predictions have been made, and none that go beyond simple emission models. In this paper, we post-process a \texttt{HARM3D} simulation snapshot of a binary at $20 M$ separation accreting at 0.01 Eddington. For black hole masses $10^6$, $10^7$, and $10^8\, M_\odot$, we self-consistently solve for the radiated spectrum on the basis of time-steady radiation transfer, thermal balance, and ionization equilibrium, including all relevant relativistic effects as well as emission and absorption processes. Although most of the bolometric luminosity is radiated thermally by the disk, the low density regions evacuated by the binary's quadrupole moment produce copious X-rays, with $\sim40\%$ of the observed luminosity in a soft X-ray power law ($Γ= 2.3$). We identify two modes of observed azimuthal variation. The X-ray continuum varies by $\sim10\%$ due to an underlying asymmetry in the gas temperature of spiral shocks in the disk. The Fe~K$α$ equivalent width dips by $\sim25\%$ when the line of sight to the inner disk is partially obscured by the lump. These two effects share the same period and are $\sim π/2$ out of phase; the period is order days to weeks for typical AGN masses and a 20$M$ separation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文通过详细的辐射传输模拟，预测了超大质量黑洞双星系统的电磁对应体，对脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）和LISA时代的引力波多信使研究具有直接意义，提供了可观测的谱特征和时变预测，新颖性和方法论严谨性均高。
decision.title_zh: 超大质量黑洞环绕双星盘的热与非热辐射：盘、冕、流与空洞
decision.abstract_zh: 搜寻超大质量黑洞（SMBH）双星系统的电磁信号是多信使天体物理学的基石之一，补充了脉冲星计时阵列和LISA对此类系统的引力波观测。尽管已进行了大量模拟以理解吸积双SMBH系统热光度的时间变化，但相对较少的光谱预测已经做出，且没有超出简单发射模型的预测。在本文中，我们对一个在20M间距处吸积、爱丁顿比为0.01的双星的HARM3D模拟快照进行后处理。对于黑洞质量为10^6、10^7和10^8太阳质量的情况，我们基于时间稳态辐射传输、热平衡和电离平衡自洽地求解辐射光谱，包括所有相关的相对论效应以及发射和吸收过程。尽管大部分热光度由盘热辐射发出，但双星四极矩排空的低密度区域产生丰富的X射线，约40%的观测光度呈软X射线幂律（Γ=2.3）。我们识别了两种观测到的方位角变化模式。X射线连续谱因盘中螺旋激波的气体温度潜在不对称而变化约10%。当内盘视线部分被团块遮挡时，Fe Kα等效宽度下降约25%。这两种效应具有相同周期，且相位相差约π/2；对于典型AGN质量和20M间距，周期为天到周量级。
